title: J.League Pro Soccer Club o Tsukurou!
native_title: Ｊリーグ・プロ・サッカー・クラブ をつくろう！
overview:
Raise the strongest squad and aim for No. 1 in the J.League!!

J.League Pro Soccer Club o Tsukurou! puts you in charge of a brand-new professional club. With a starting budget of one billion yen, choose a hometown from 609 locations across Japan, name your team, and pick its manager and players to take on the real-named stars of the J.League.

Run the front office by managing facilities, staff and gate revenue, while training your players into top performers. On match day you don't control the players directly: set the formation and tactics and watch the game unfold with live announcer commentary.

- Sports management and training simulation
- Password battles for up to 8 players with your clubs
- Memory backup support
- Officially licensed by the J.League

最強軍団を育て上げてJリーグNO.1をめざせ!!
